{{Current events|year=2019|month=12|day=8|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Saudi Arabian-led intervention in Yemen]], [[Yemeni Crisis (2011–present)]]
**[[Sudan]]ese [[Prime Minister of Sudan|Prime Minister]] [[Abdalla Hamdok]] says the [[Government of Sudan|government]] has reduced the number of [[Sudanese Armed Forces]] troops in [[Yemen]] from 15,000 to 5,000, saying the conflict "can no longer be solved militarily".  [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-sudan-politics/sudan-says-it-has-reduced-troops-in-yemen-to-5000-idUKKBN1YC0HX?il=0 (Reuters)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2019 Delhi factory fire]]
**Forty-three workers are killed in a fire in a factory in [[Delhi]], [[India]]. [https://bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-india-50703659 (BBC)] 

;Law and crime
*[[Women's rights in Saudi Arabia]]
**The [[Ministry of Municipal and Rural Affairs (Saudi Arabia)|Ministry of Municipal and Rural Affairs]] of [[Saudi Arabia]] announces that [[Sex segregation|gender-segregated]] entrances are no longer mandatory for restaurants. This change is not considered compulsory however, and there are no announcements for similar changes to other public institutions. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/12/saudi-arabia-ends-gender-segregated-entrances-restaurants-191208171725619.html (Al Jazeera)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2019 Hong Kong protests]]
**After a massive march in the city, [[Civil Human Rights Front]] leader and [[Rainbow of Hong Kong]] activist [[Jimmy Sham]] says "it is the last chance for [[Carrie Lam]] to listen to the people". [https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/international/world-news/hong-kong-protesters-mark-half-a-year-of-protest-with-mammoth-rally/articleshow/72430246.cms (''Economic Times India'')]
*[[2019 Sammarinese general election]]
**Citizens of [[San Marino]] are called to the polls in the first round to elect the 60 members of the [[Grand and General Council]]. [https://www.ilrestodelcarlino.it/rimini/politica/elezioni-san-marino-2019-1.4927174 (''Il Resto del Carlino'')]
*[[Politics of Finland]]
**The [[Social Democratic Party of Finland]] selects [[Minister of Transport and Communications (Finland)|Minister of Transport and Communications]] [[Sanna Marin]] for [[Prime Minister of Finland|Prime Minister]], following the resignation of [[Antti Rinne]]. If confirmed, she will become Finland's youngest ever Prime Minister and the world's youngest serving Prime Minister at age 34. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-finland-government-pm/finlands-social-democrats-name-marin-to-be-youngest-ever-prime-minister-idUKKBN1YC0JQ (Reuters)]
*[[2019 Lebanese protests]]
**Businessman Samir Khatib withdraws his candidacy for the [[Prime Minister of Lebanon|Prime Minister]] position after failing to secure enough votes from the [[Lebanese Sunni Muslims|Sunni Muslim]] bloc last week. This leaves the ousted [[Saad Hariri]] as the only potential candidate. Massive protests are formed outside the [[Parliament of Lebanon|Parliament]] building in response to Hariri’s possible return. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/12/lebanon-hariri-emerges-pm-candidate-khatib-withdraws-191208192459108.html (Al Jazeera)]
